children: The staffing company's consolidated revenue rose 15 per cent to Rs 4,396 crore, while profit after tax increased 44 per cent

Quess Corp crossed the 5-lakh workforce milestone in the second quarter of FY27, with its total headcount reaching approximately 5.04 lakh at the end of September 2026. The company added more than 20,000 associates to its general staffing business during the quarter, alongside securing 116 new client contracts.
The company's total headcount increased from 4.83 lakh in the year-ago quarter, marking a year-on-year rise of around 4 per cent, according to its Q2 FY27 earnings release.

The general staffing business reported a headcount of approximately 4.90 lakh during the quarter. It generated revenue of Rs 3,823 crore, up 15 per cent year-on-year, while earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) increased 23 per cent to Rs 57 crore.

The segment's workforce comprises associates recruited, employed or managed by Quess and deployed at client organisations to meet their staffing requirements. These employees work across sectors including manufacturing, retail, telecom, banking, financial services and insurance.
Quess announced its second-quarter financial results on 30 October 2026, reporting consolidated revenue of Rs 4,396 crore, a 15 per cent year-on-year increase.
Adjusted EBITDA rose 20 per cent to Rs 92 crore, while profit after tax increased 44 per cent to Rs 75 crore.

In the professional staffing segment, global capability centres (GCCs) contributed 71 per cent of both headcount and revenue. Banking, financial services and insurance, along with technology-related verticals, emerged as key growth areas.
The segment added 27 new client contracts during the quarter.
